title: Keyboard-first rollouts inspector: focus-roaming & localized cost counters prototype review
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Goal: Validate a keyboard-first interaction model for the Rollouts Inspector panel and the adjacent Cost Counters strip when the UI is localized (wide number formats, different thousands/grouping separators, and RTL languages). We need a prototype that demonstrates predictable focus order, resilient focus rings that do not clip on narrow widths, and readable affordances that do not rely on color alone. This ticket covers design exploration, a Figma prototype, cross-browser focus behavior notes, and an accessibility + localization checklist for handoff to engineering.

Scope:
- Rollouts Inspector list (variant rows, canary toggle, percent bars)
- Top-of-page Cost Counters (tokenized numeric metrics and microcopy)
- Variant inspector flyout (details panel) and its keyboard close/escape handling
- Localized states for: en-US, de-DE, fr-FR, ja-JP, ar-SA (LTR/RTL)

Out of scope: full Console dashboard restyling, backend telemetry changes.
acceptance_criteria: Tab order matches visual reading order in both LTR and RTL locales
Focus ring (high-contrast and default themes) is fully visible for all interactive elements at font-size as small as 12px and at compact density
Number formatting in Cost Counters does not cause layout shifts that break focus target size (min 32x32px tappable target)
Screen reader announces rollouts variant name, percent, and canary state in a single concise statement when focused
Prototype includes a fallback visual (pattern + icon) in addition to color to indicate variant health/status
Engineering handoff includes CSS variables and test cases for RTL flip, number width edge-cases, and focus outline preservation
design_decisions: Use border-based focus ring with 3px outline-offset instead of box-shadow for predictable clipping across overflow containers
Numbers in Cost Counters use tabular-nums font-feature to reduce horizontal jitter when localized
Replace color-only status chips with an icon + patterned background (diagonal hatch) for sufficient contrast and color-blind friendliness
When RTL is active, ensure tab sequence is mirrored and the visual focus rectangle animates from the logical start rather than absolute left
Combine aria-label + aria-describedby to provide short SR summary and link to a live region for dynamic percentage updates
tasks: Finalize Figma frames for en-US and ar-SA (Maya)
Create CSS token spec for focus outline and tabular numerics (Luis)
Write accessibility test cases for SR output and keyboard traversal (QA: Priya Raman)
Implement small-viewport manual test checklist for i18n team (Localization: Omar Haddad)
test_plan: Keyboard only sweep across rollouts list: confirm focus lands on row, toggle, percent bar, and details button in order
Screen reader (NVDA + VoiceOver) focus check: single-line announcement containing [variant name] — [status] — [percent]
Localized layout test: de-DE and ar-SA builds with long microcopy to validate truncation rules and ellipsis + tooltip behavior
Contrast test: color+pattern chip against both light and dark console themes meets 4.5:1 for text/icon
Mobile narrow viewport: ensure touch target size >=32px and focus ring does not overflow clipped container
notes: Observed issue from spike: percent bar uses a pseudo-element that clips focus outline when the row has overflow hidden — resolved in prototype by moving outline to parent element
Localization note: Japanese numbers reduce digit width, but currency microcopy can push counters beyond container — use scale-down policy with tooltip on hover/focus
We rejected increasing container padding to preserve compact density — decision documented in Figma comments
